post.title: CoreWeave grew 168% and still lost $709 million
post.ig:
This AI company grew 168% and still lost money.
CoreWeave's Q3 revenue: $3.66 billion, up 168% from a year ago.
It raised its 2026 forecast to $13-13.3 billion.
But it lost $709 million last quarter, with $37-39 billion of spending planned this year.
Shares jumped by double digits in premarket trading Wednesday, before the opening bell.
Sources: CoreWeave Q3 2026 release (Nov 10), CNBC (Nov 11).
